scope: Preparation of the support zone, bedding, haunch and selected backfill for 850 m of an explicitly selected DN/OD 315 pipeline trench. Geotextile, foundation aggregate, 180 m3 project bedding/surround material, selected backfill, warning tape, preparation, compaction, testing, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are direct project inputs.
sourceAuthority: Approved pipeline and geotechnical design organizations, material suppliers, construction laboratory and approving project engineer
forbiddenClaims: pipe supply or laying, manholes, connections or whole-network testing
material, earthwork, labor or mechanism quantities derived from route-length coefficients
automatic unsuitable-soil replacement, dewatering or shoring
